title: A GitHub Actions CI Workflow
description: A workflow that runs on every push and pull request, sets up Python 3.12, installs dependencies, and runs the test suite.

steps.description: This is a GitHub Actions workflow. The comment names its path, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. It defines one job named `test` that runs on `ubuntu-latest`.
`on: [push, pull_request]` is the trigger. Your automated checks attach to the development process here.
The steps check out the repository and set up Python 3.12.
`pip install -r requirements.txt` installs the project's dependencies.
`python -m pytest tests/ -v` runs the test suite. This is the second line where your checks attach.

steps.question: The page calls CI "the referee that no agent can" do what?
